search_scope: Public YouTube metadata and storyboards for international One Piece card collection/binder footage; Japanese card faces prioritized, with actual language kept distinct from metadata language.
metadata_method: Isolated yt-dlp 2026.08.19 probes with node JS runtime, public watch-page formats, no cookies/accounts/proxies. Positive listed 3840x2160 dimensions establish an available 2160p encode.
minimum_resolution_rule: At least 1440p source height; native 2160p preferred. This acquisition selected only listed 3840x2160 formats.

acquired_excerpts.visual_evidence: Inspected source-resolution decoded frames. The excerpt contains two different 3x3 binder-page layouts side-by-side; many cards are repeated copies within each page. Page faces remain large in the 4K frame, roughly 500-700 source pixels tall by visual estimate. No exact card names/printing labels are asserted.
quality_limits: Hands cover lower pockets while turning/pointing.
Strong sleeve/foil glare obscures some right-page faces, especially several pockets in the first spread.
Small persistent Japanese title strip runs across the top edge.
Cards are mostly upright, but binder pages are curved/tilted and their pocket edges can overlap.
The nine retained frames are concentrated on two page layouts and are highly temporally related; they are not independent test examples.
acquired_excerpts.timestamp_caveat: 110-125 are requested yt-dlp section bounds. Segment keyframe seeking can shift actual decoded start; frame manifest timestamps are excerpt-relative frame index / reported-fps values, not guaranteed frame-accurate source timestamps.

overall_result: Three distinct international candidates were positively format-verified at native 3840x2160. One Japanese-language binder walkthrough yielded a useful short excerpt and nine selected unlabeled 4K frames. Two candidates were not downloaded after thumbnail/storyboard review. Exact identities, rights and independent validation status remain unestablished.
